response: Yes, expert breast pathology assessment is necessary for the management of ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS). Accurate diagnosis and classification of DCIS by a specialized breast pathologist are crucial for determining the appropriate treatment and ensuring the best possible outcomes. Expert pathology assessment helps to confirm the diagnosis, assess the extent and grade of the disease, and identify any associated high-risk features, which are essential for guiding treatment decisions and optimizing patient care.
